title: US CNC Machine Company
description:
Sector: Precision CNC Machining, Metal Manufacturing, Industrial Components Manufacturing | Location: United States | Employees: 101 | Revenue: $43 million | Deadline: 2026-11-28 14:41 UTC
HESQUANDOR presents itself as a precision manufacturing company specializing in CNC milling, CNC turning, and custom metal component production. The company claims to provide precision-machined parts and manufacturing solutions for industrial applications, including prototyping and production services.
